thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 502s and upstream timeouts detected for region 'us-lakefront' - error rate 8% over baseline for last 5m. Paging: @paul_oncall (pager duty).
paul_oncall: on it. grabbing metrics + recent deploys. can someone start customer-impact triage?
sre_john: i'm seeing 502s from lakefront-gateway -> proxy-pool-3, concurrent connection errors (ECONNRESET) and 504s at the edge. tail latency 95p is 1.2s higher.
marta_dev: no deploys in lakefront in last 30m. autoscaler didn't kick. could be a headroom / tcp conn leak.
paul_oncall: lia_support, any customer reports?
lia_support: a few priority customers reported intermittent failures on inference API, around 5-10% of requests returning 502. CS has initial list, escalating most impacted.
paul_oncall: ok. engops, can we isolate traffic away from proxy-pool-3? suggest gradual shift to pool-1 & pool-2 while we debug. need rollback-safe steps.
engops_bot: starting controlled shift: add routing tag lakefront=fallback-1 -> weight 15% at t=8765432120. monitor 1m.
paul_oncall: note: do NOT remove fallback routes entirely — keep slow ramp. we want small blast radius.
sre_john: logs show proxy-pool-3 hitting outbound connection spikes to model-hosts (kvm-worker nodes) then RST. possible kernel file-descriptor exhaustion.
nisha_ops: checking host metrics for pool-3. seeing elevated open_fds and small rise in accept queue length. also memory pressure on a few nodes.
marta_dev: can we drain the worst nodes? commands: 
```
# drain sequence
apictl pool drain proxy-pool-3 --node node-7,node-9 --grace 60
```
paul_oncall: proceed with drain of node-7 first, then node-9. keep one node as control.
engops_bot: reroute at t=8765432140: lakefront routing weights update -> pool-3 -10%, pool-1 +5%, pool-2 +5%.
lia_support: customer comms draft: "We are investigating elevated 502 errors in US Lakefront region. Some requests may fail intermittently. We're mitigating by shifting traffic to healthy proxy pools. We'll update in 30 minutes." Want to publish?
paul_oncall: send now. include mitigation steps and expected degraded performance window. :loud_sound:
sre_john: after draining node-7 we see a 40% drop in 502 rate for pool-3, before weights changed. suspecting a bad kernel patch or fd leak in that node's runtime. capturing strace and netstat.
marta_dev: collecting core dumps and tcp info. attaching snippet: 
```
netstat -anp | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l
> 48k
lsof -p 2345 | wc -l
> 19842
```
This node is above safe fd threshold.
nisha_ops: continuing to drain remaining unhealthy nodes and increase pool capacity: scaling pool-1 by +3 nodes.
engops_bot: pool-1 scaled +3 nodes at t=8765432155. autoscaler now at requested.
paul_oncall: observation: overall region 502 rate dropped to 2.3% after reroute + drains. keep 15m observation window before fully shifting traffic.
lia_support: CS updated customers with "Mitigation in progress, partial traffic reroute, expected improvement in next 15-30 min." responses: some customers still report errors during in-flight requests, likely due to sticky connections.
sre_john: root cause hypothesis: a memory leak in proxy runtime that manifests under certain long-lived connections causing fd exhaustion and RSTs. reproducing locally.
marta_dev: patch ready to close FD cleanup edge-case. will push to canary pool-2 once we confirm no regression.
engops_bot: canary deploy of proxy runtime patch to pool-2 at t=8765432168. Canary nodes: node-21,node-22.
paul_oncall: good. watch canary error rate and end-to-end latency. if stable for 10m, roll patch into pool-1/pool-3 drained nodes.
lia_support: update sent: "Canary deployment underway; we will roll the fix broadly if metrics remain stable. We will follow up in 10 minutes."
sre_john: canary looks good so far — no fd spike and 502 rate on canary <= 0.5%.
marta_dev: initiating rollout to drained nodes; will bring them back gradually after patch.
engops_bot: rolling patch to drained node-7 at t=8765432175 -> success. node re-added to pool-3.
paul_oncall: current status: 502s dropped to baseline ~0.6%, region latency normalized. keeping thread open for 30m to monitor. postmortem owner assigned: marta_dev. action items: 1) backfill kernel fd limits and alerts, 2) safety check during long-lived conn patterns, 3) automate pool draining runbook.
lia_support: noting customers notified, will follow up when incident is closed.
paul_oncall: thanks all. closing page once 30m stable window completed. :white_check_mark:
